card.name: Ever, all, everywhere before a clause
card.fires_on: Small words like ever, all, of, just, anything and everywhere that sit in the middle of a phrase and are about to be followed by a noun phrase or completion such as 'since', 'the odds' or 'its trappings'. Found in general web prose.

modes.label: All in set phrases
modes.description: The word all inside fixed phrases such as against all the odds, after all that work or with all its trappings.

modes.label: Ever since / everywhere
modes.description: Ever or everywhere used as an adverb meaning always or in every place.
modes.example: This is the card trick I learned in 6th grade and have used it<< ever>> since.

modes.label: Other quantity words
modes.description: Words like of, just or anything in superlative or emphatic phrases.
modes.example: were<< anything>> but trivial, and the raison d’

card.writes: It pushes toward the next word being a noun-like or labelled continuation, not 'everything' or 'everywhere' forms.
card.plain: It fires on little emphasis words like all, ever and anything that come before the rest of a phrase.
